functions.name: Num
functions.docs: Returns the number of rows stored.

functions.name: Reserve
functions.docs:
Reserve space for additional row handles. This allocates memory but doesn't add new row handles. If the requested count is less
than the current count then nothing happens.

functions.name: Shrink
functions.docs: Reduces the amount of memory used by the array to exactly fit the current number or elements.

functions.name: Add
functions.docs: Appends the provided row handle at the end of the array. This may result in the array becoming unsorted and/or no longer unique.

functions.name: Append
functions.docs: Append the provided list of rows to the end of the array. This will make the array unsorted and not unique.

functions.name: Remove
functions.docs:
Removes the provided row. If the array is sorted, a binary search will be used to find the row, but requires moving all
subsequent rows down. If the array is not sorted a linear search is required but the last row will be moved into the removed
location for quicker removal.

functions.name: Remove
functions.docs:
Removes the provided list of rows. If the array is sorted, a binary search will be used to find the row, but requires moving all
subsequent rows down. If the array is not sorted a linear search is required but the last row will be moved into the removed
location for quicker removals.

functions.name: Contains
functions.docs:
Checks if the provided row is stored in this array. If the array is sorted a faster binary search is used, otherwise a linear
search is required.

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs:
Removes all row handles, but keeps the allocated memory around. If the provided size is larger than the number of rows
that fit in the container then extra memory will be allocated so there's enough space for the new number of rows.

functions.name: Empty
functions.docs:
Removes all row handles and releases all allocated memory. If the provided slack size is not zero then memory is
reserved for at least the provided number of rows.

functions.name: Sort
functions.docs: Sorts the row handles in numerical order from lowest to highest.

functions.name: Sort
functions.docs:
Sorts the row handles in numerical order from lowest to highest. This version is faster as it doesn't need to allocate
a temporary intermediate array. ScratchBuffer has to be at least as large as the number of rows in the array.

functions.name: MakeUnique
functions.docs: Goes through the array and removes any duplicate entries. If the array isn't sorted it will be sorted first.

functions.name: ReduceToDuplicates
functions.docs:
Goes through the array and only keeps a single instance of any value that appears twice or more. If the array
isn't sorted it will be sorted first. After this function completes the array only contains unique values.

functions.name: SortedMerge
functions.docs: Merges the provided array into the array while remaining sorted. The provided array is expected to be sorted.

functions.name: GetRows
functions.docs: Constructs a view of the array to provide access to its rows.

functions.name: IsSorted
functions.docs: Whether or not the contained rows are numerically ordered from smallest to largest.

functions.name: IsUnique
functions.docs: Whether or all rows in the view only appear once.

functions.name: IsEmpty
functions.docs: Whether or not there are any values in the view.
